comparison_type: failure-family only, not paired scoring or causal before/after comparison

families.v2_evidence: V2-KQ-02 and KQ-05 formed no EVIDENCE dependency; V2-DA-07 missed an authorized diary RESOURCE dependency. V2-KQ-04/10 formed false diary dependencies.
families.v3_evidence: All eight V3 knowledge cases formed/satisfied EVIDENCE and all eight DA cases READ_DIARY; however V3-DA-07 formed a diary dependency after direct numeric facts failed extraction, and V3-PD-04 formed a questionable VALIDITY_STATE dependency for latency.
families.limit: Different goals/fixtures mean the exact V2 miss is not independently retested. This is evidence of wider coverage, not complete resolution.

families.v2_evidence: Six available V2 summary-shaped fixtures lacked cardinality/date/provenance and correctly failed closed, leaving analyses incomplete.
families.v3_evidence: Six V3 available diaries were entry-shaped and projected 4/4, 6/6, 3/3, 5/5, 4/4, 5/5 with valid dates/provenance. No valid summary-shaped V3 fixture exercised the historical mismatch.
families.limit: V3 supports entry-shaped integrity, not a claim that the V2 summary-shaped contract mismatch is resolved.
